keyEvents.text: Goal! Lazio 1, Lecce 0. Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Gustav Isaksen with a cross.
Delay in match because of an injury Youssef Maleh (Lecce).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Lazio 1, Lecce 0.
Jamil Siebert (Lecce) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Danilo Veiga (Lecce).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Lecce. Oumar Ngom replaces Mohamed Kaba.
Substitution, Lecce. Paco Esteban replaces Willem Geubbels.
Goal! Lazio 2, Lecce 0. Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Kenneth Taylor.
Substitution, Lecce. Joël Monteiro replaces Youssef Maleh.
Danilo Veiga (Lecce) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Lazio. Luca Pellegrini replaces Alfonso Pedraza.
Substitution, Lazio. Matteo Cancellieri replaces Gustav Isaksen.
Substitution, Lazio. Nicolò Rovella replaces Reda Belahyane.
Substitution, Lazio. Fisayo Dele-Bashiru replaces Tijjani Noslin.
Substitution, Lecce. Nikola Stulic replaces Konan N’Dri.
Substitution, Lecce. Sadik Fofana replaces Lassana Coulibaly.
Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Lazio. Albert Gudmundsson replaces Andrea Pinamonti.
Goal! Lazio 3, Lecce 0. Davide Frattesi (Lazio) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Matteo Cancellieri with a headed pass following a fast break.
